title: Photographs and videos
slide_intent: Select assets with both identity and permitted use in mind because a convenient photograph may be unsuitable for a specific communication.
strategic_value: Helsinki’s own material banks can supply more distinctive city imagery than widely reused stock.
demonstration: This webpage component lists four city image banks, asks users to check image-specific terms and consent information, and separately discusses Adobe Stock and Unsplash. Its broad Unsplash licensing statement is a source claim, not verified legal guidance.
practical_value: Start with city banks, check each image’s terms and consent needs, and assess whether stock fits the brand.

content_islands.name: City image sources
content_islands.spec: Place the four image-bank links above terms and consent guidance.

content_islands.name: Stock alternatives
content_islands.spec: Follow with the brand-fit caveat and Adobe Stock/Unsplash references.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explains that stock may be widely reused and does not comply with the brand.
reference_purposes.Application: It identifies city image banks and directs users to terms attached to individual images and consent forms.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Adobe Stock availability is scoped to city employees with an Adobe software license; image use remains subject to the relevant terms.
